import pandas as pd, re, json
from datetime import date

pd.set_option("display.width", 200)
pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth", 90)

INTAKE_DATE = date(2026, 10, 12)   # today, per system date

# ---------------- 1. RAW INTAKE (as reported) ----------------
raw = {
    "claim_ref":          None,                     # NOT SUPPLIED
    "policy_number":      "CP-2024-1187",
    "named_insured":      "Harborview Retail LLC",
    "claimant":           "Harborview Retail LLC",
    "claimant_role":      "Named insured / policyholder",
    "policy_eff":         "2024-01-01",
    "policy_exp":         "2024-12-31",
    "loss_location":      "4820 Meridian Ave N, Seattle, WA 98103",
    "date_of_loss":       "2024-11-15",
    "date_reported":      None,                     # NOT SUPPLIED
    "reported_by":        None,                     # NOT SUPPLIED
    "loss_description":   "pipe burst in the store's back room",
    "jurisdiction_state": "WA",
}

# ---------------- 2. CANONICALIZER ----------------
CANON_RULES = [
    (r"(burst|broken|ruptured|split)\s*(water\s*)?pipe|pipe\s*(burst|rupture|failure|break)",
     ("Water Damage", "Escape of water - plumbing system failure", "WTR-PLUMB-BURST", 0.95)),
    (r"sewer|drain\s*back[- ]?up|backup of sewer",
     ("Water Damage", "Backup of sewer or drain", "WTR-SEWER-BU", 0.90)),
    (r"sprinkler",
     ("Water Damage", "Sprinkler leakage / discharge", "WTR-SPRINKLER", 0.85)),
    (r"flood|storm\s*surge|overflow of (a )?(body of water|river)",
     ("Flood", "Flood / surface water (commonly excluded)", "FLOOD", 0.90)),
]

def canonicalize(text: str):
    t = text.lower()
    for pat, (cat, sub, code, conf) in CANON_RULES:
        if re.search(pat, t):
            return cat, sub, code, conf
    return "Unclassified", "Requires adjuster review", "UNK", 0.00

cat, sub, code, conf = canonicalize(raw["loss_description"])

# "back room" -> normalized premises descriptor
PREM_NORMALIZE = {"back room": "back room (stockroom / non-public area)"}
prem = raw["loss_description"]
for k, v in PREM_NORMALIZE.items():
    prem = prem.replace(k, v)

canonical_narrative = (
    f"On {raw['date_of_loss']}, a plumbing pipe ruptured in the {prem.split('the ')[-1]} "
    f"of the insured retail premises at {raw['loss_location']}, causing an escape of water "
    f"and resulting damage to [building interior / business personal property / stock - TO BE CONFIRMED] "
    f"at the described premises. Reported cause: plumbing system failure "
    f"(non-flood, non-sewer-backup)."
)

# ---------------- 3. BIND + VALIDATION ----------------
dol = pd.Timestamp(raw["date_of_loss"]).date()
eff = pd.Timestamp(raw["policy_eff"]).date()
exp = pd.Timestamp(raw["policy_exp"]).date()

bind = {
    "policy_bound_to_claim": True,
    "within_policy_period":  eff <= dol <= exp,
    "days_into_term_at_dol": (dol - eff).days,
    "days_remaining_at_dol": (exp - dol).days,
    "days_dol_to_intake":    (INTAKE_DATE - dol).days,
}

record = pd.DataFrame({
    "Field": list(raw.keys()),
    "Value": ["<MISSING>" if v is None else str(v) for v in raw.values()],
    "Source": ["Reported by user"] * len(raw),
})

canon = pd.DataFrame([{
    "Standardized loss category (L1)": cat,
    "Standardized loss type (L2)":      sub,
    "Internal cause code":              code,
    "Match confidence":                 conf,
    "Reported language (verbatim)":     raw["loss_description"],
    "Canonical loss description":       canonical_narrative,
}]).T.rename(columns={0: "Value"})

bind_df = pd.DataFrame({"Item": list(bind.keys()),
                        "Value": [str(v) for v in bind.values()]})

print("="*115); print("CLAIM INTAKE RECORD - RAW"+" "*60); print("="*115)
print(record.to_string(index=False))
print("\n"+"="*115); print("CANONICALIZED LOSS DESCRIPTION"+" "*60); print("="*115)
print(canon.to_string())
print("\n"+"="*115); print("POLICY BIND / PERIOD VALIDATION"+" "*60); print("="*115)
print(bind_df.to_string(index=False))
